title: LADAKH // HIGH-ALTITUDE PASS
historicalBasis: High-Altitude Himalayan Crisis Telemetry (Zojila / Siachen sector analog). Calibrated with DRDO SASE (Snow and Avalanche Study Establishment) and public military communications field studies in sub-zero alpine environments (-35°C battery capacity collapse, 5,500m steep ridgeline RF knife-edge diffraction, and satellite look-angle line-of-sight shadowing).
syntheticDisclaimer: Command entities, scenario injects, and tactical units are synthetic training constructs.

environment.weatherDescription: Severe blizzard at 5,400m pass; -35°C temperature, 90 km/h squalls, heavy knife-edge mountain RF shadowing.

events.message: Routine high-altitude weather telemetry: Wind 45 knots, ambient temp -28°C.

payload.content: Relay solar-battery buffer stable at 90%. Pass corridor transit clear of snow drift.

events.message: BLIZZARD INGRESS: Temperatures plummet to -38°C. Lithium battery chemical reaction rates collapse 65% across relay masts.
TOTAL POWER EXHAUSTION: Mountain Ridge Relay 04 battery bank frozen. Primary UHF mountain mesh offline.
Recon Patrol Sierra reports massive avalanche blocking main military transit axis.

payload.content: CRITICAL TRANSIT BLOCKAGE: Class 4 wet-slab avalanche triggered from north ridge. Highway buried under 6 meters of hard-packed snow for 400m.

events.message: CONTRADICTION: Automated acoustic geophone sensor transmits false clearing signal, conflicting with Sierra's visual.

payload.content: STALE SENSOR: Pass acoustic sensor registers vibration subsided and auto-clears alert (sensor frozen solid in ice pack; zero vibration detected due to ice casing).

events.message: SATELLITE SHADOWING: Steep 5,800m granite ridge intercepts low-angle geostationary satellite beam during patrol movement.
Valley Forward Aid Post establishes direct connection over cold-hardened wire-line.

payload.content: Wire-line link clear: Avalanche Rescue Detachment has reached wire terminal. Confirming road blocked; requesting tracked snow-cat convoy redirect to secondary valley.

decisionWindows.situation: Relay 04 has frozen dead and ridge terrain is shadowing SatCom uplinks. An ice-fouled sensor falsely claims the pass is open while Patrol Sierra visually confirms a 6-meter avalanche blockage. You must evaluate sensor vs scout reliability, switch to direct cold-hardened field wire-lines, and redirect supply convoys to the secondary valley bypass.
